G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.controlled: C0,C1,S0-S4 once per B0/B1/B2: 21 fresh workers. Same fixture replay across builds. Cold startup and every recurring call reported separately.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.observer: C1 in six fixed blocks with build orders [B0,B1,B2], [B1,B2,B0], [B2,B0,B1], [B2,B1,B0], [B1,B0,B2], [B0,B2,B1]: 18 additional fresh workers. Six per build, no outcome-dependent reruns.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.measured: M0 is C0 evaluation with latency_mode=measured and codriver_delay=0.005; one fresh B0/B1/B2 worker each, three total. Descriptive readiness/validity only; no trace equality or statistical performance claim.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.protocol_worker: One fresh worker for U01-U20 plus the five listed existing regression nodes, no unrestricted suite.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.clock_worker: One separate stdlib-only fresh worker, exactly 1000 empty single spans and 1000 empty two-level nested span pairs; include both endpoints, append and clock counts; retain all raw records. No backend imports or BLAS calibration.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.observer_capture_rule: Controlled parity harness can use bounded test-only in-memory spies equally across builds; their times are not overhead estimates. The separate 18 observer workers disable dense spies/copying in all builds and preserve minimal returned outcomes. All source/config matches are verified before each block.
G2_sample_plan_PROPOSED.statistics: Report all run-level paired CPU/wall differences, counts, extrema and raw order, including negative deltas. Six observer replicates per build are descriptive, not p99/reliability estimates; no launch-level independence or hardware bound claim.
